Class ShopReviewRepositoryImpl

java.lang.Object
com.dianping.shopdetail.repository.ShopReviewRepositoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ShopReviewRepository
@Repository public class ShopReviewRepositoryImpl extends java.lang.Object implements ShopReviewRepository
实现ShopReview仓储，负责数据库查询及持久化模型转换。
